reason: A real Edit PDF attempt made the browser app unresponsive. The editor's existing-content inspection performed unbounded paragraph reconstruction and quadratic fallback table-grid connectivity work on the browser main thread after worker inspection returned. Dense text/vector PDFs could therefore monopolize the UI during editor opening.
affected_workflows: Edit PDF / open existing PDF for editing
notes: Bounds UI-thread paragraph reconstruction and fallback table-recovery pair work, preserves the full vector inspection for editing, and adds a 30-second abortable native-inspection responsiveness budget that fails soft to overlay editing. The user's private PDF is not stored or committed; regression coverage uses synthetic in-memory inspection structures. Issue #31.
